gates.S0_sample: a cell needs >= 50 signals in RESEARCH, >= 20 in IS and >= 15 in VAL; below that the verdict is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, never a pass
gates.S1_existence: in IS, the mean signed forward return at some horizon > 0 and its bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0
gates.S2_replication: the same horizon has a positive mean in VAL, a block the horizon was not chosen on
gates.S3_economic: VAL mean gross - full round-trip cost (fee + half spread + slippage + impact at 500 USDT) > 0, and the VAL mean gross at least covers the fee floor (20 bps, or 15 bps with the BNB discount)
gates.S4_multiple_testing: the cell survives Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.10 inside its stage's test family
gates.S5_holdout_integrity: no input row, signal or statistic covers 2026-08-06 -> 2026-08-20; the holdout is never read
gates.S6_governance: config/runtime.yaml still declares paper with live_trading_enabled false, no live order exists, and this experiment changes no risk limit
gates.S7_null_baseline: a coin-flip signal with the same cadence and the same exit policy must fail S1-S4; if it does not, the gates are measuring costs and not edge
